Best Anime Coming In 2027 — Most Anticipated Anime Of 2027.  with Kagurabachi, Chainsaw Man, Frieren, Jujutsu Kaisen, Demon Slayer, Solo Leveling, Dan Da Dan, Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint and MORE coming in 2027!

These are the most anticipated anime of 2027 — from massive returning seasons to brand-new anime adaptations that could completely dominate the anime community.

We thought 2025 was peak anime.

Then 2026 happened.

And somehow… 2027 looks even more ridiculous.

Kagurabachi is finally getting its anime adaptation. Chainsaw Man is returning with the Assassins Arc. Frieren continues with the Golden Land Arc. Jujutsu Kaisen is heading deeper into the Culling Game. Demon Slayer continues Infinity Castle. Solo Leveling is coming back. Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint is finally making the jump from manhwa to anime.

And that's only the beginning.
